# XINGYUJI ATELIER

> An appointment-only atelier in Bellevue, Washington, making one-of-a-kind silk Qipao and
> made-to-order garments for clients in the greater Seattle area. Work is cut and constructed
> to each client's own measurements rather than to a standard size chart.

This file summarises the site for assistants and AI crawlers. The public pages may be read,
quoted, and cited with attribution. Garment designs and photographs remain the property of the
studio — see Terms before reproducing imagery.

## What the studio does

- One-of-a-kind Qipao, photographed as real garments rather than renderings.
- Made-to-order commissions built from measurements taken in person.
- Relevant pieces are made from 100% mulberry silk sourced from Japan. Metallic-thread content
  is disclosed individually. Natural silk varies in weave, hand, and dye lot; slight variation is
  a property of the material rather than a defect.

## Portfolio

The portfolio is a record of work, not a catalog.

- **Ready-to-wear** cards are pieces currently available. Waist adjustment may be available when
  construction allows.
- **Archive** pieces are marked unavailable. They were made to order for a client and are shown as
  a record of the studio's work. A new commission is an original design, not a reproduction of a
  sold piece.

## Pricing

- Made-to-order Qipao starts at **$650 before applicable tax**. Additional layers, piping, pattern
  matching (对花), and advanced techniques may increase the price.
- Bellevue sales tax of 10.3% is applied to the pre-tax total.
- Zelle payment receives 3% off, applied to the subtotal before tax. The calculation appears on
  every invoice. Zelle payments are final and non-reversible.
- Made-to-order commissions begin with a $300 production deposit.
- Alterations to a ready-to-wear piece take 7–11 days and are paid in full before work begins.
- Quoted prices are held for 3 days unless stated otherwise.
- Nothing is charged automatically on this site. Every order is confirmed by invoice first.

## Timing and collection

- Typical made-to-order production is 4–6 weeks from an approved work order.
- Completed with a local final try-on and pickup in Bellevue, by appointment, typically weekday
  evenings 7:30–9:00 PM.
- Shipping may be arranged case by case for returning clients after the balance is paid; orders
  dispatch within 3–5 business days of cleared payment, with tracking sent by email.

## Returns

- Made-to-order garments are final sale once the work order is approved and the production deposit
  is paid. Fit is confirmed at the final try-on before pickup.
- Pieces purchased at the studio are final sale, regardless of additional alteration performed by
  the studio.
- Ready-to-wear that has been shipped may be returned within 3 days of delivery, provided it is
  unworn, unaltered, unwashed and in original, resalable condition. Returns are not accepted after
  that period. The studio provides the return label; its cost, and the original outbound shipping,
  are deducted from the refund.
- If an item arrives damaged or is not what was invoiced, email the studio within 3 days of
  delivery with photographs; it will be repaired, replaced, or refunded.

## Privacy

- Only the information needed to answer an inquiry, produce a garment, and issue an invoice is
  collected.
- Measurements and body data are confidential, are never published or shared, and are deleted on
  request once a commission is complete.
- No personal information is sold, rented, or traded. No advertising trackers or third-party
  analytics profiling are used. Full payment card numbers are never stored.
